{npc:Seymour}, head of the Rookgaard Academy, is looking for a suitable gift box to offer the king. You get the {item:Present} from a chest near the Bear Room Quest and swap it with Seymour for a {item:Legion Helmet} (or keep the present as a collector's item).
Seymour is looking for a suitable box that he wants to give to the king.
There is only one {item:Present} per character in Rookgaard.

The chest is at the bottom of the main Rookgaard cave, on the same floor as the {wiki:Bear Room Quest}. Bring a {item:Rope}.
Go to the **abandoned building** a little **north** of the village of Rookgaard and go down the hole.

Go **east** and go down (there are {creature:Troll|Trolls}). Go down again as shown on the map (a few {creature:Orc|Orcs}) and go down once more (2 to 4 Orcs, easy to shake off). You reach a room with 1–2 {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and a few Orcs, with a **big table**.

**North of the big table** is the switch that controls the stone at the door of the bear room. The Present chest is **right next to this switch**.
Open the chest near the Bear Room
Go to the {wiki:Bear Room Quest} area. Near the room, next to a lever, there is a chest with a {item:Backpack} that contains a {item:Present}, a {item:Jug}, a {item:Plate} and a {item:Cup}. Take it.
On the way there are {creature:Orc|Orcs}, 2 {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and a {creature:Bear}.
Keep the backpack and the Present. The Jug, the Plate and the Cup are useless.
Backpack with Present, Jug, Plate and Cup
Go back the same way: climb the floors through the same holes (use the {item:Rope} where needed) to the abandoned building north of the village.

If you also enter the bear room ({wiki:Bear Room Quest}) and someone blocks the exit with the stone, go down through the sewer grate to a room with 4 {creature:Spider|Spiders} and go up the stairs to the **south** to return to the central room of the Minotaurs and Orcs.
Go to the Rookgaard Academy and talk to {npc:Seymour}. Say {key:hi}, then {key:present box} (or just {key:box}) and {key:yes}. He exchanges the Present for a {item:Legion Helmet}.
A player who intends to stay in Rookgaard may prefer to keep the {item:Present}: it is lighter and it is a collectible item, because you can only get one in Rookgaard.

{item:Legion Helmet|Legion Helmets} are worth a little more on the mainland because {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} no longer drop them, and they are still needed for an outfit quest ({wiki:Citizen Outfits Quest}).
